newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks to trade half day on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks to trade half day on Tuesday.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong will hold only a morning trading session on Tuesday, the exchange said.
The Hong Kong Futures Exchange said Hang Seng Index futures, sub-index futures and Hang Seng Index options will only be traded in the Tuesday morning session.
Both exchanges will observe Christmas holidays on Wednesday and Thursday, December 25 and 26.
Trading on both exchanges will resume as normal with morning and afternoon sessions on Friday, December 27.
